# Prompts Book by Muhammad Nasir Khan — llms.txt
# Standard machine-readable context file for LLMs, AI agents, and search indexers.

> Project: Prompts Book
> Creator & Lead Developer: Muhammad Nasir Khan
> Classification: World #1 Benchmark for AI Video & Audio Prompt Engineering
> Target Engines: Kling 4.0, Higgsfield Cinema Studio & Seedance 2.0/2.5, Hailuo MiniMax, Wan 2.1, CogVideoX, HunyuanVideo, Runway Gen-3, OpenAI Sora, Luma Dream Machine, Suno AI, Udio v1.5, Adobe After Effects

## Executive Summary
Prompts Book is an open-source, production-grade prompt engineering framework and prompt library created by Muhammad Nasir Khan. It unifies professional cinematography, optical camera controls, motion graphics, audio-visual rhythm math, FACS micro-expressions, multi-shot character identity consistency, and sound design into repeatable, deterministic prompt architectures.

## Core Frameworks & Compilers
- MCSLA Video Framework: Model, Camera, Subject, Look, Action/Audio. (video-generation/frameworks/mcsla-framework.md)
- FACS Facial Micro-Expressions: Anatomical Action Unit (AU) muscle directing, Duchenne markers, and dialogue micro-beats. (video-generation/frameworks/facs-facial-micro-expressions.md)
- Character Consistency & Soul ID Standard: 10-parameter identity anchors, 6-panel 3x2 reference turn-arounds, and ghost-mannequin state tracking. (video-generation/frameworks/character-consistency-and-soul-id.md)
- Video-to-Video (V2V) & VFX Transformation: Plate preservation doctrine, 4K footage transforms, and photometric edge lighting. (video-generation/frameworks/video-to-video-and-vfx-transformations.md)
- Multi-Model Video Dialect Matrix: Syntactical compilers for Kling 4.0, Runway Gen-3, OpenAI Sora, Luma, and Seedance. (video-generation/frameworks/model-dialect-matrix.md)
- Multi-Model Camera Dialects: Cross-engine camera syntax translation across Kling, Higgsfield, Hailuo, Wan 2.1, CogVideoX, and HunyuanVideo. (video-generation/camera-and-cinematography/multi-model-camera-dialects.md)
- Higgsfield Cinema Studio & Camera Controls: 35+ named camera presets (Dolly, Crane, Orbit, FPV Drone, Snorricam, Bullet Time), optical lens profiles, and diffuse lighting controls. (video-generation/camera-and-cinematography/higgsfield-cinema-studio-controls.md)
- Master Camera Movement Catalog: 40+ industry-standard named movements. (video-generation/camera-and-cinematography/camera-controls.md)
- Vox-Style Motion Graphics: Paper collage dioramas and multi-beat timeline prompts. (video-generation/motion-design-and-vfx/vox-style-motion-graphics.md)
- Talking Heads & Social Reels: 6-part presenter formula, crash-zoom hooks, and lipsync limits. (video-generation/prompts-by-genre/talking-heads-and-social-reels.md)
- Vibe-Motion & Infographics: Kinetic charts, metric tickers, and typography stings. (video-generation/motion-design-and-vfx/vibe-motion-infographics.md)
- Audio-to-Video BPM-to-FPS Sync Engine: Mathematical lookup tables mapping musical BPM to video frame cuts at 24fps, 30fps, and 60fps. (video-generation/frameworks/bpm-to-fps-sync.md)
- Key-to-Fill Lighting Ratios: Contrast control ratios (1:1 to 8:1). (video-generation/frameworks/lighting-key-ratios.md)
- Temporal Consistency & Multi-Shot Rules: Decoupling character identity from motion dynamics. (video-generation/frameworks/temporal-consistency-rules.md)
- Shutter Angles & Motion Blur: 180-degree rule and kinetic clarity. (video-generation/camera-and-cinematography/shutter-speed-and-motion-blur.md)
- Suno 7-Element Audio Architecture: Genre, Mood, Instrumentation, Vocal Style, Production, Technical BPM/Key, Structure. (audio-generation/prompt-anatomy/seven-elements-formula.md)
- Udio v1.5 Manual Mode Guide: Weighted descriptor clouds, manual mode sliders, and modular generation. (audio-generation/prompt-anatomy/udio-prompting-guide.md)
- Frequency Spectrum Allocation: Audio EQ partitioning for video voiceovers. (audio-generation/production-field-guide/frequency-mixing-guide.md)
- Musical Dynamic Intensity Tags: Tension, drop hits, and volume modulation. (audio-generation/metatags-and-structure/dynamic-intensity-cues.md)
- Aspect Ratio Guide: Resolution and geometric framing standards. (visuals-and-storyboards/aspect-ratio-guide.md)
- HyperFrames Code-to-Video Editing: Whisper word timestamps, GSAP templates, brand tokens, and HTML-to-MP4 production rendering. (video-generation/motion-design-and-vfx/hyperframes-code-editing.md)
- YouTube Research & Outlier Protocol: Channel outlier multipliers, breakout inflection detection, and contact-sheet visual analysis. (video-generation/youtube-research-and-scripts/youtube-research-and-analysis-protocol.md)
- Audience Bullseye & Hook Machine: 5-Ring audience targeting (`3-2-2` mix) and data-backed hook rubrics. (video-generation/youtube-research-and-scripts/audience-bullseye-and-hooks.md)
- Viral Script Engineering: 150 WPM pacing, retention arcs, and AI-tell elimination. (video-generation/youtube-research-and-scripts/viral-script-engineering-and-linting.md)
